phase: Deletion candidates. Twenty rounds showed one pattern: deleting a word from a prohibition moved the plans (v30), rewriting a prohibition into a description did not (v31, v35). v36 deletes the sentence that discounts the citizen own card mix; v37 deletes the blanket licence to substitute one fulfillment for another. Neither adds a word.
primary: Paired per-citizen composition distance against the v18 v25 arm, resampling citizens. Success is a 95% interval that excludes zero on the closer side. The same test on v34 gave -0.0198 [-0.0855, +0.0405], so a difference under about 0.06 cannot be told apart at this roster size.
limitations: Only citizens who bought something in both arms form a pair; v18 gave 35 pairs out of 60.
The control arm is reused from v18 rather than re-run. Same cohort, same source file, same seed 70001, same pipeline.
Home dwell hours are NOT a target this round. tel_home_wd_time is not a 24-hour partition and our scorer adds the whole night to home; see experiments/HOME_HOURS_IS_NOT_DWELL.md.
Sixty citizens cannot resolve an answer-key indicator sign. v20 carries that question.
preflight: 277 unit checks passed including 6 new resource-gate regressions. Source, v25 and asset_transaction_v7 unchanged from the previous round.
